stem.en: A made-up stock of fish starts at 100 thousand. It grows by 30% a year, and then the catch is taken out. Three fleets each take 30 thousand a year. How many thousand fish are left at the end of the first year?

explanation.en: The stock grows first and the catch comes after. 100 thousand grows to 130 thousand. Three fleets take 90 thousand between them, which leaves 40 thousand.

hints.en: Work out the growth first, then take away the catch of all three fleets.
Together the three fleets take 3 x 30 thousand.
